question: Where is the company that developed the Surya VHF radar based?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Surya VHF radar** was primarily developed by **Mistral Solutions**, a leading technology design and systems engineering company headquartered in **Bengaluru**, **Karnataka**.
 
• This sophisticated radar system was developed in close collaboration with the **Electronics and Radar Development Establishment (LRDE)**, which is a premier laboratory of the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**, also located in **Bengaluru**.
 
• The **Surya radar** is a **3D Active Electronically Scanned Array (AESA)** radar that operates in the **Very High Frequency (VHF)** band, designed specifically for long-range surveillance and detection of aerial targets.
 
• It is particularly effective at detecting **stealth aircraft** because the physical properties of **VHF waves** make them less susceptible to the **Radar Cross Section (RCS)** reduction techniques used in modern stealth technology.
